meta.title: Urgent service request · YukSaroy
meta.description: Need a locomotive, wagon repair or a crane: one request, nearby providers send offers.

kindDesc.LOCO_CALL: Wagons are stuck at a station or a siding, a shunting locomotive is needed.
kindDesc.WAGON_REPAIR: A fault on the way: a repair crew has to come on site.
kindDesc.CRANE: A crane is needed to lift heavy cargo or a container.

public.title: Locomotive, repair or crane with one request
public.lead: The request goes by Telegram to locomotive services, equipment owners and carriers in your region and the neighbouring ones. They offer a price and an arrival time, you choose.
public.ctaNote: Login required, the request takes a minute.

s1.title: Request
s1.body: Type, region, station, wagon count and phone. Nothing else is needed.

s2.title: Offers
s2.body: Nearby providers write a price and an arrival time. Only you see the offers.

s3.title: Choice and status
s3.body: You pick one offer. Send the public status link to partners, it carries no prices.

public.noPrice: Only the request owner sees prices. The public status page shows none.

band.title: Are you a provider?
band.body: If your organization is a locomotive service, equipment owner or carrier, requests from your region appear in the dashboard. With Telegram linked you also get a message.

statusPage.noPrice: No prices are shown on this page. The link is safe to share with partners.

mine.title: Urgent requests
mine.lead: Locomotive, repair or crane requests and the offers they received.
mine.empty: No requests yet. A new one takes a minute.
mine.notReady: The urgent service is not live yet. Try again shortly.

form.descriptionPh: What happened, when it is needed, which wagons

detail.statusLinkHint: Share with partners: price and phone stay hidden.
detail.sent: Sent to {count, plural, one {# provider} other {# providers}}.
detail.sentNone: When it was sent, there were no providers in this region.
detail.stillVisible: Your request is still visible to providers.
detail.confirmClose: The request will be closed and no new offers will arrive. Continue?
detail.awardedNote: Provider chosen. Close the request once the job is done.

provider.title: Open requests
provider.lead: Open urgent requests in your organization's regions and the neighbouring ones. Put a price and an arrival time in the offer.
provider.empty: No open requests right now. A Telegram message arrives when a new one comes in.

offer.title: Send an offer
offer.sent: Offer sent. If the customer picks you the status changes in the dashboard.
